subject: Consortio exec workshop — visitor access, badging & site security
messages:
From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@consortio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@consortio.com, events@consortio.com
Date: 2026-09-14T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Consortio visit: exec workshop — badging & site access

Hi Marissa / Jordan,

We're finalizing logistics for the Consortio executive workshop on Sep 23–24 at Redwood's SF office. A few items we need to lock down from your side so we can circulate to internal stakeholders:

- Visitor pre-registration: does Redwood accept a CSV import for names + company + phone + ID type, or do you require individual invites?
- Badging: will badges be printed on arrival, or do you provide pre-printed badges for VIPs? Any limits on badge types (temporary vs escorted)?
- Escort policy: are our execs required to have a Redwood escort at all times? We have two non-standard guests (external auditors) who need limited lab access.
- Network access: for a short demo we need VPN/secure tunnel or guest Wi-Fi with access to a hosted demo environment — what is allowed?
- Security documentation: our InfoSec team is asking for the site entry/visitor policy and a point of contact for on-site security escalations. If you can share an SOC 2 or equivalent summary that would help.

Can you confirm next steps and any templates you prefer for the attendee list? We hope to provide the final names by Sep 20 EOD.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rios
Head of Events — Consortio Financial
elena.rios@consortio.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@consortio.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consortio visit: exec workshop — badging & site access

Hi Elena — great to hear from you. Excited to host Consortio. High level answers below and an outline of next steps so we can align by Sep 20:

- Pre-registration: we prefer a single CSV import (name, company, email, phone, government ID type + last 4). I'll attach a template (redwood-badging-template.csv).
- Badging: we will pre-print badges for executives and VIPs if names are received 72+ hours before arrival. All other attendees get a print-on-arrival temporary badge.
- Escort policy: general rule is visitors must be escorted in non-public areas. Auditors that require lab access will need a scoped escort and a signed lab access form; we'll coordinate with your security team.
- Network access: temporary VPN credentials are possible for demos that require access to a partner environment; open guest Wi‑Fi is available but firewalled. If you need a VPN tunnel, our Network team needs the destination IPs and an architecture diagram — we can provision time-limited credentials.
- Security docs & contact: attaching our onsite-guidelines.pdf and listing Ben Carter (Security Ops) as the primary on-site contact.

Next steps:
1) You send the completed attendee CSV by Sep 20 12:00 PDT.
2) We'll provision pre-printed badges for executives and generate a visitor manifest.
3) If VPN is required, provide whitelist IPs by Sep 18 so Jordan can spin up access.

Attaching: redwood-badging-template.csv, onsite-guidelines.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@consortio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consortio visit: exec workshop — badging & site access

Elena — adding a few operational items from the Solutions/Network side:

- We'll set up a dedicated check-in table in the lobby with a badge printer and an escort assignment sheet (we'll provide two escorts per event day depending on headcount).
- For auditors needing lab access: please confirm the two auditors' legal names, organization, and reason for access; Ben will run background checks per our visitor policy.
- VPN: If you need access to a demo host behind your firewall, please send the destination hostnames/IPs and required ports by Sep 18. We'll generate time-limited credentials and provide a runbook.
- Parking & arrival: VIPs can use reserved valet passes; regular attendees should use the visitor parking row (map in Drive link below).

I'll attach the badging template again for convenience. If helpful, we can run a brief 15-minute call to walk through the check-in flow (I have availability Sep 17 morning).

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@consortio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@consortio.com, events@consortio.com
Date: 2026-09-15T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consortio visit: exec workshop — badging & site access

Thanks — attaching the vendor/site intake form and our security contacts CSV. We should be able to get most of the VIP names to you by EOD 9/20; full list follows on 9/21 COB.

Attachments: Consortio-Vendor-Site-Form.pdf, consortio-security-contacts.csv

On the auditors: both are external contractors; I'll include their info in the CSV and flag the lab access requirement.

Elena

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@consortio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consortio visit: exec workshop — badging & site access

Got it — thanks for the forms, Elena. Quick operational notes:

- I'll run the background checks for the auditors once we have full legal names and DOBs (we only need last 4 of SSN for US contractors, see our intake form).
- We'll produce a visitor-badge-manifest-20260923.csv on Sep 22 morning and circulate to your security team for confirmation.
- On-site escalation: Security Ops hotline +1 415-555-0202; tiered escalation matrix included in onsite-guidelines.pdf.

I'll be the on-site security lead. If anything changes with headcount, please flag asap.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Security Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@consortio.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consortio visit: exec workshop — badging & site access

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments. Confirming final timeline and asks so nothing slips: 

Checklist & timeline:
- By Sep 18: if VPN is required, send destination IPs/hostnames + ports to jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com.
- By Sep 20 12:00 PDT: Consortio provides CSV with VIPs marked for pre-print and auditors with required identity fields.
- Sep 22 morning: Redwood will send the visitor-badge-manifest-20260923.csv for review.
- Sep 23–24: check-in table open 8:00–17:00; security lead Ben Carter on site; two escorts assigned each day.

On-site check-in flow (short):
1) Guest arrives at lobby, sign-in at check-in table.
2) Security validates government ID and matches to manifest.
3) Badge printed (VIPs pre-printed), escort assigned if required.
4) Escort accompanies guest to meeting room; guests return badge at exit.

Parking & arrival: valet passes for VIPs; regular visitor parking at Lot B (map: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-consortio-onboard).

Please confirm you can meet the CSV timeline. If so, we'll treat this as final and pull the badge manifest on Sep 22.

Looking forward to hosting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0177
